summary: FASE 6 — Maintenance Mode + AI Insights + Modular Routes — ALL FEATURES VERIFIED WORKING. Backend pytest 12/12 PASSED (100%). Frontend: MaintenanceScreen renders properly with placeholder interpolation when enabled=true and disappears when enabled=false; MaintenanceConfig seller page renders all expected data-testid elements; AI Insights card on Dashboard General tab fully populated with real Claude Sonnet 4-6 generated content (forecast, restock suggestions, key insights, action items, refresh button).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~2443 lines — only 2 modules (maintenance + ai_insights) extracted in FASE 6. Per previous reviews (>700-line guideline), further extraction of push/orders/dashboard routers still recommended for next phase.

routes/__init__.py is minimal (just now_iso helper). Good decoupling pattern — setup(api_router, db, require_seller[, manager]) injects deps cleanly from server.py line 2438-2441, avoiding circular imports.

ai_insights cache TTL=1h hardcoded as CACHE_TTL_HOURS=1 constant. Acceptable for MVP; consider making configurable via store_config.dashboard_config if seller wants more aggressive refresh during testing.
ai_insights properly excludes mongo _id via projection {'_id': 0} on products + orders queries. ✓
MaintenanceConfig PUT uses model_dump() + filters None, so partial updates merge correctly without wiping unset fields. test_put_partial_does_not_wipe_other_fields PASSED confirms this.
WebSocket broadcast in PUT /api/maintenance wrapped in try/except — broadcast failure cannot break the PUT. Good defensive coding.
MaintenanceScreen.js correctly interpolates {return_date} via formatReturnDateOnly + {return_time}. Verified live: 'm {return_date}' became 'm Minggu, 15 Februari 2026'.

BuyerApp polling interval 60s for /api/maintenance. Public endpoint, lightweight — OK. Combined with WebSocket broadcast, perceived latency for buyer is <60s but typically much faster on websocket-connected sessions.
AI prompt explicitly forbids markdown wrappers, but defensive cleanup at lines 173-179 handles ```json fences if Claude regresses. Good.
